observations.details: Each row is mandatory; no sample may be skipped, renamed, replaced, merged, or deferred. Catalog fields must be limited to id,title,stack,theme,requirements,ports,sourcePath and must drive list, copy, README index, package inventory, and validation matrices.
observations.title: Exact ten-project coverage matrix

observations.details: For every sample directory, add one focused test per behavior: directory exists; LICENSE exists and is MIT; lock file exists for the native package manager; deterministic seed fixture exists and produces stable snapshot; stack-native persistence exists; native test entry exists; page/API health endpoint exists; declared port is unique and overridable; forbidden files/strings are absent: .launchdeck.yml, Launchdeck dependency/import, Launchdeck questionnaire/answers, scoring, evaluation, telemetry, node_modules, virtualenv, build output, runtime DB/logs, binary vendoring.
observations.title: Static standalone purity checks

observations.details: Add catalog-contract tests for exact ten IDs, uniqueness, field allowlist, source path containment under examples/sample-projects, real source directory existence, unique ports, and no handwritten duplicate inventory. Add CLI tests for launchdeck example list human output at 60 and 120 columns, --no-color, --json single schemaVersion 1 object, --json --compact single compact object, non-TTY no prompt, catalog invalid/missing/duplicate/path-escape failures, and help text grammar.
observations.title: Deterministic list tests

observations.details: Add one behavior per test: explicit ID to default ./<id> succeeds without prompt; explicit ID plus destination succeeds; copied tree matches source snapshot and excludes Launchdeck config/artifacts; success receipt includes id, source, absolute destination, file count/digest and no implicit install/run next action; unknown ID returns stable typed failure; omitted ID in non-TTY and JSON returns command_usage_error and never prompts; TTY omitted ID opens searchable selector; TTY search select succeeds; TTY no-match preserves no-mutation state; TTY cancel leaves no target/staging. Destination/error paths: existing file, existing empty dir, existing nonempty dir, symlink/junction target, parent missing, parent is file, staging-name collision, catalog source missing, source path escape, copy fault, rename fault, cleanup fault. Assertions: staging is created in destination parent only, atomic rename is final publish, failures remove target and staging when publish did not succeed, and retry after correction is explicit.
observations.title: Deterministic copy success and failure matrix

observations.details: Package plan: package.json files must include the complete gallery root and catalog, while root install must not include sample dependencies or workspaces. Gate uses actual npm pack evidence, not static assumptions: run prepack, pack to temp, parse pack JSON/tar inventory, assert exact ten sample directories and catalog are included, existing agent payload remains included, no forbidden sample artifacts are present, repository source/copy/tarball digests agree, packedSize<=5*1024*1024 and unpackedSize<=20*1024*1024, and any drift blocks release.
observations.title: npm pack allowlist inventory and size gates

observations.details: For each sample and each OS in windows-latest and ubuntu-latest: copy sample to an isolated temp directory; install native dependencies using the sample lock file; run native compile/build where applicable; run native tests; start service with catalog port override; poll declared HTTP/API health with bounded retries; stop through the native process owner; assert port released, process exited, no runtime files/logs/database artifacts remain in source, and temp copy cleanup succeeds in finally. Docker sample requires docker compose config/build/up health/down -v and skip only if runner lacks Docker with explicit CI failure or separate prerequisite gate, not silent pass.
observations.title: Windows/Linux native lifecycle matrix

observations.details: For each sample and each OS in windows-latest and ubuntu-latest: create a fresh temp copy from source and a separate LAUNCHDECK_HOME; external fixture authors a reviewable candidate .launchdeck.yml only in the temp copy; run launchdeck doctor --json, tasks --json, setup/build/test aliases or run equivalents, start/up with port override, HTTP-or-API health, logs/status/ps evidence, stop/down in finally, reconcile if stale, and clean only against temp copy. Assert original sample source remains free of .launchdeck.yml and Launchdeck runtime artifacts.
observations.title: Windows/Linux Launchdeck compatibility lifecycle matrix

observations.details: Quickstart scenario owner: quickstart-validation. Use fastapi-inventory because it exercises API health and Python dependency isolation. Steps: launchdeck example list --json; verify fastapi-inventory row; launchdeck example copy fastapi-inventory <temp>/fastapi-inventory --json; inspect copied LICENSE/lock/tests/seed/API; run native install/test/start with port override; stop; externally author candidate .launchdeck.yml in temp copy; launchdeck doctor --json; launchdeck test --json; launchdeck start --json; poll /health or documented API endpoint; launchdeck stop --json in finally; compare evidence receipts. Expected: schemaVersion 1 list/copy receipts, native tests pass, health 2xx, Launchdeck-owned process stops, source remains pure. Recovery: unknown ID rerun explicit ID; destination conflict choose empty path; copy/rename failure verify no residue then retry; port conflict choose override; health timeout collect logs/status then stop/reopen lifecycle task.
observations.title: Representative quickstart scenario

observations.details: Partition fast deterministic contracts under npm test; package inventory/size under package-gallery on Ubuntu; sample-native matrix by OS and sample with fail-fast false and per-sample timeout; launchdeck-compat matrix by OS and sample with isolated temp copies and finally cleanup. Controls: unique port allocation from catalog plus override offset per worker, serial lifecycle inside each sample, bounded health polling instead of sleeps, no network during copy, npm/pip/go/maven/dotnet caches only at install layers, artifact upload for receipts/logs on failure, process cleanup trap/finally, no hidden macOS assertion.
observations.title: CI partitioning and flakiness controls

observations.details: Review risks: sample rows copied into README/tests instead of deriving from catalog; generated Launchdeck configs leak into sample source or tarball; root package begins installing sample dependencies; CI silently skips a sample/platform; Docker prerequisite ambiguity; package size drifts over gates; copy rollback masks cleanup failures; macOS evidence is implied from existing CI. Stop/reopen if any exact ID/stack/theme changes, a sample needs non-LTS tooling or external services, copy requires install/network/git/config, package exceeds 5MiB/20MiB, Launchdeck evaluation/scoring enters sample content, or Windows/Linux lifecycle cannot be made deterministic.
observations.title: Review risks and stop/reopen conditions
